title: Dutch police seek victims of fake webshops; 29-year-old from Meppel arrested
date_note: Security.nl's article is dated 24 November; the page gives no earlier day for the arrest.
geo_basis: country, as the source gives no police unit; the suspect is from Meppel
summary: According to Security.nl, Dutch police arrested a 29-year-old man from Meppel who allegedly took more than 47,000 euro through fake webshops. Police say he was active through 29 domain names selling fashion and furniture, and that they have more than 250 victims in view; it probably involves hundreds. Police are asking further victims to come forward.
plain: Dutch police arrested a man they suspect of running fake online shops. They have more than 250 victims in view and are asking others to come forward.
exec: Police say the fake shops allegedly took more than 47,000 euro through 29 domain names.
action: General advice: anyone who believes they were a victim of these shops and did not get a police letter can contact the police, as Security.nl reports.

evidence.quote: In de zaak is een 29-jarige man uit Meppel aangehouden die vermoedelijk meer dan 47.000 euro heeft buitgemaakt.
De verdachte was via 29 domeinnamen actief, waarop hij mode en meubels aanbood.
De politie heeft op dit moment meer dan 250 gedupeerden in beeld.

validation.note: Only Security.nl read, relaying the police announcement; the police page was not found.
